before: A join adopted the following text of each planned paragraph once, in order. An adoption into a later paragraph could move an embed out of an earlier one and leave a copy beside a hidden duplicate there, which then showed as that paragraph's following text. That paragraph had already adopted, so its write typed the text again as new characters, and it showed twice.
after: The planned paragraphs adopt again until none shows following text, at most once more than there are planned paragraphs.
reason: It writes the same kind of adoption a join already writes, with existing fields and operations, so older clients read it as before. Shared fields, operations, and synchronization keep their meaning.
